# Hook catalog

Register a hook in a consumer by name, one line per hook, in `.claude/settings.json`
and `.codex/hooks.json`, by absolute path. Claude Code: `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.dpe-agent-config/hooks/agent/run <name>`; Codex: `bash "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.dpe-agent-config/hooks/agent/run" <name>`. A relative path resolves against the session's working directory, and a launcher it cannot find exits 127, which does not block. Not listed = not
running.
`MANDATORY` hooks must be registered on their event in both files (`verification.sh lint`
enforces this); optional hooks are the consumer's choice.

| Name               | Event                | Mandatory | Description                                                                        |
| ------------------ | -------------------- | --------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `aws-readonly`     | `PreToolUse:Bash`    | yes       | Blocks aws/pulumi calls that don't name a read-only AWS profile (dev or prod).     |
| `block-rm`         | `PreToolUse:Bash`    | yes       | Blocks `rm -rf` (recursive and force together), whatever the target.               |
| `infra-readonly`   | `PreToolUse:Bash`    | yes       | Blocks pulumi commands that alter infrastructure or stack state.                   |
| `log-instructions` | `InstructionsLoaded` | no        | Claude Code only. Appends every InstructionsLoaded event to prove on-demand loads. |
| `pr-body`          | `PreToolUse:Bash`    | no        | Checks a `gh pr create`/`edit` body for the required blocks and keeps it short.    |
